Waaree Energies Shares Dip Amid US Customs Solar Cell Tariff Probe

Waaree Energies' shares experienced a decline following a US Customs ruling concerning potential tariff evasion on solar cell imports from Vietnam and Malaysia. The company faces the possibility of a significant tariff increase, which could impact its reputation. Despite a clarification from US Customs, the shares continued to fall.
